implementation: RP2040-only direct cubic binomial pow near1. Exact Q160 linear term, exact129-bit quadratic product with one floor, bounded Q32 cubic coefficient, existing certified integer division, radius4 Q160 guard. Full-mantissa exponent gate avoids displacing existing short-integer paths. An ambiguous cell retains the existing full refinement.

instruction_summary.small_dispatch_overhead: Several existing pow group means increase by up to17 instructions; all retain fewer instructions than their Qfplib references. Near-one-large hard stream grows17.4 mean instructions and remains faster.

certificate.scope: Exact rational inequalities and all discrete exponent/side range checks. Linear term exact; one quadratic floor; Q32 cubic coefficient with Lipschitz and product-floor bounds; reuse of the existing certified RNE divide-by3 inside its input domain; fourth-order Taylor remainder. Source hashes bind the certificate to the inspected helper and existing division code. Compiled arithmetic, rounding-cell acceptance and public ABI require the independent ARM test. No universal pow-totality or physical-speed claim.

compiled_binomial_test.scope: Compiled ARM helper: every accepted result encloses an independently formed exact-rational cubic Taylor interval strictly inside its binary64 rounding cell, and matches directed MPFR. Includes all 96 nonzero base displacements, exponent-domain edges, both signs, random full significands, and the saved hard-pow corpus. Selected full public calls validate integration. Finite coverage; see the separate algebraic domain certificate. No hardware-cycle or totality claim.

all12.oracle: Directed MPFR bounds; both endpoints round to the same binary64 (RNE).
all12.abi: Every call verifies R4-R11, SP, bounded stack writes.
all12.semantics: RNE return values; errno and floating exception flags are not implemented.
all12.nan_result_policy: NaN results must be quiet; payload and sign are unspecified.
known_limitations: An undecided owned 1024-bit pow refinement still traps; all-input totality is unproved.
all12.scope: Finite corpus, not an exhaustive proof over every binary64 input.

instruction_matrix.scope: Executed ARM instructions on the prepared finite corpus, with typed 32-bit return masking. If sides_share_elf is false, owned production symbols and pinned diagnostic Qfplib symbols run on separate instances of the same Cortex-M0 emulator. When actual_bootrom is present, SDK ROM lookup initializers, wrappers and ROM bodies execute without intrinsic models. SIO division remains functionally modeled. These are not hardware cycles, cache comparisons, timings, or proof of speed parity.

hard_profile.scope: Seeded reservoir of published hard pow inputs in three explicit finite domains. Positive normal bases and bounded logarithm-products keep the composed Qfplib ln/mul/exp comparison meaningful. Actual production/diagnostic ARM and captured ROM execute on separate identical emulator instances. Instruction counts are not physical cycles or timings. This is additional coverage, not a replacement for the 114-group matrix or an all-input proof.

affected_corpus.oracle: Directed MPFR bounds must round to the same binary64; signaling NaNs separately require a quiet NaN result.
affected_corpus.abi: Every ARM call verifies R4-R11, SP and bounded stack writes.
affected_corpus.scope: Saved worst-case corpus; not a totality proof over all binary64 pairs.
known_limitations: The owned 512/1024-bit fallback preserves a final undecided-interval trap; totality is unproved.

affected_selector.selection: Every non-unit positive base within [1-2^-47,1+2^-47] whose exponent has nonzero low32 encoding bits. This includes every new helper call from the public dispatcher, including exponent-domain declines.

resources_and_link.scope: Only the RP2040 dispatcher and new binomial helper change numerical code. Prior native functions retain identical object bytes; four other numeric objects including their relocation targets are identical. Non-pow linked functions retain addresses/sizes and have identical bytes or calls to recursively equivalent targets. Scratch object payload and all main-RAM boundaries are identical; two RAM veneer slots are permuted and the two callers are checked against equivalent targets. The existing rsqrt seed payload moves80bytes. This is semantic and placement evidence, not physical XIP/cycle evidence.

M4_isolation.scope: Cortex-M4 O3 release, both soft and hard float ABIs: normalized preprocessing and every allocated code/data section identical; existing M4 runtime sources byte-identical

generic_M0_isolation.scope: Non-RP2040 generic ARMv6-M: every allocated code/data section remains byte-identical to V60. The generic spelling has an extra expression macro; normalized preprocessing identity is not claimed.

diagnostic.scope: Owned production ELF and unchanged pinned diagnostic Qfplib ELF execute on separate identical ARM emulator instances with the captured16KiB ROM. No V90 physical diagnostic was installed.

prior_full_million_scope: The1,003,177-case complete run belongs to V86 and is not relabeled as a V90 run. Every787 entry reaching V90 new gate was selected exhaustively and requalified. Other paths retain object/link identity evidence; finite qualification is not a universal totality proof.
remaining: Two hard pow streams remain substantially slower than Qfplib in executed instructions.
General pow totality remains unproved outside the224 exact-stage exponents; the final undecided interval trap remains.
Physical timing and cache effects await final accepted platform/memory composition and explicit USB release.
